sentences.text: In terms of the FIR registered on 31.03.2024 under Section 354 & 506 IPC it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 16 years was misbehaved by the applicant on 29.03.2024 and thereafter, he ran away.
Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. recorded on 01.04.2024, the victim stated that on the said date, wrong was also committed on her.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. recorded on 03.04.2024, the victim reiterated that wrong was done to her.

The medical of the victim was done on 01.04.2024 i.e. immediately after recording of the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and after about three days of the alleged incident, the same did not point out to any external or internal injury; the hymen was found to be torn.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact fact that in the FIR, no allegations of rape was levelled and the medical done after three days does not corroborate the incident which allegedly occurred on 29.03.2024, the applicant who has no criminal history and is in custody since 06.04.2024 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ram Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
